# cpanel_email_auto_responder (Data Source)

Looks up one cPanel email autoresponder and its current schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_auto_responder" "away" {
  email = "away@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The complete responder email address on a mail domain owned by the cPanel account.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String) The autoresponder message body with cPanel's trailing newline normalized.
- `charset` (String) The message character set.
- `from` (String) The display name used in autoresponder messages.
- `interval_hours` (Number) Hours cPanel waits before replying again to the same sender.
- `is_html` (Boolean) Whether cPanel adds an HTML content type to the message.
- `start_unix` (Number) Unix activation timestamp, or `0` for immediate activation.
- `stop_unix` (Number) Unix deactivation timestamp, or `0` when no stop is configured.
- `subject` (String) The autoresponder message subject.
